Public Function MakeBases(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, p As Object, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 1
        Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
        Set p = wb.Worksheets(1).Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 50, 120, 60)
        If i = 1 Then p.AlternativeText = "D": p.Title = "T": p.Decorative = True: p.Rotation = 30: p.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue: p.Locked = False
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\" & IIf(i = 0, "plain", "set") & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    MakeBases = "ok"
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal base As String, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, p As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\" & base & ".xlsx")
    Set p = wb.Worksheets(1).Shapes(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    s = "|" & p.AlternativeText & "," & p.Title & "," & p.Decorative & "," & p.Rotation & "," & p.LockAspectRatio & "," & p.Locked
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        p.AlternativeText = "A box"
    Case 2
        p.Title = "Box"
    Case 3
        p.AlternativeText = "x & <y>": p.Title = "T"
    Case 4
        p.Decorative = True
    Case 5
        p.Rotation = 30
    Case 6
        p.IncrementRotation 400
    Case 7
        p.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue
    Case 8
        p.Locked = False
    Case 9
    Case 10
        p.AlternativeText = ""
    Case 11
        p.Title = ""
    Case 12
        p.Decorative = False
    Case 13
        p.Rotation = 0
    Case 14
        p.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
    Case 15
        p.Locked = True
    Case 16
        p.AlternativeText = "New": p.Title = "Other"
    End Select
    Tried = "ok" & s & "|" & p.AlternativeText & "," & p.Title & "," & p.Decorative & "," & p.Rotation & "," & p.LockAspectRatio & "," & p.Locked
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(0, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(1, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(2, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(3, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(4, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(5, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(6, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(7, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(8, "plain", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(9, "set", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(10, "set", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(11, "set", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(12, "set", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(13, "set", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(14, "set", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(15, "set", folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(16, "set", folder)
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
